pages.text: Every conversion gem is crafted around a star, and the star comes back: it is a reusable catalyst. Better bees need better stars.$(br2)$(l)Lesser Bubba Star$(): 10 bees.$(br)$(l)Bubba Star$(): 19 bees.$(br)$(l)Celestial Bubba Star$(): the 10 ore bees.
The Lesser Bubba Star is used up here.
Not crafted: a Bubba Star becomes celestial in the $(l:rituals/night)Celestial Ritual$(/l), one night under open sky. Every ore bee's gem needs it.
